review_notes: I read the whole file and checked how its lemmas are used. I also read contractionForm_add, _sub, _smul and _sum, and the call sites of contractionForm_list, matrix_ofReal_list and rowLevel_sum. The file has no @[simp] attributes. Its only simp-interface surface is the pair of list-sum lemmas, contractionForm_list and matrix_ofReal_list. Both are used only through explicit `simp only [...]` calls, in Assembly.lean (line 47) and in NormalCertificate.lean (line 26). The sibling contractionForm_* lemmas are also never tagged @[simp], so there are no competing rules. Tagging the file's list-sum lemmas @[simp] would be a style change with possible downstream side effects. It would not fix a concrete simp failure, so I did not report it. I found no rewrite in the wrong direction, no unwanted expansion and no plausible cycle. I did not run Lean, so the remaining uncertainty is whether any downstream `simp` calls would benefit from a global attribute. I found no evidence that they would.
